name: Plantasonic Botanical Asset Definitions
description: Metadata-only definitions for every botanical specimen in the installation. No images are stored here. Assets are generated on demand by the Generative Asset Pipeline using these definitions plus the Style DNA. This is the populated botanical asset checklist.

schema.name: human readable display name
schema.category: botanical family grouping used by the scene graph
schema.promptSubject: the subject clause fed to promptBuilder (style is added from Style DNA)
schema.styleDNA: ref or inline override of style-dna.json
schema.cacheLocation: relative path under assets/cache once generated, else null

assets.name: Unfurling Fern
assets.description: A single fiddlehead fern caught mid-unfurl, fractal spirals glowing from within.
assets.promptSubject: an unfurling fiddlehead fern, fractal spiral fronds, glowing veins
assets.notes: Hero asset for calm intro states.

assets.name: Monstera Leaf
assets.description: Fenestrated monstera leaf, bioluminescent perforations, deep jungle palette.
assets.promptSubject: a fenestrated monstera deliciosa leaf, bioluminescent holes, deep veins

assets.name: Ghost Orchid Bloom
assets.description: A ghostly orchid blossom, translucent petals, accent-colored pollen glow.
assets.promptSubject: a ghost orchid flower in bloom, translucent petals, glowing pollen
assets.notes: Bloom event asset, triggered by audio onsets.

assets.name: Luminous Moss Cluster
assets.description: A dense cluster of glowing moss, fine filament detail, soft radial bloom.
assets.promptSubject: a dense cluster of bioluminescent moss, fine glowing filaments
assets.notes: Used as background filler and layer fog.

assets.name: Bioluminescent Mushroom
assets.description: A tall bioluminescent mushroom, gilled underside glowing, spore haze.
assets.promptSubject: a tall bioluminescent mushroom, glowing gills, drifting spores

assets.name: Climbing Vine Tendril
assets.description: A reaching vine tendril with coiled tip, used for transitions and growth.
assets.promptSubject: a climbing vine tendril with a coiling tip, small glowing nodes

assets.name: Succulent Rosette
assets.description: A geometric succulent rosette, near-symmetric, faint edge glow.
assets.promptSubject: a geometric succulent rosette, near-symmetric leaves, faint edge glow

assets.name: Glowing Seed Pod
assets.description: A bursting seed pod releasing luminous seeds, particle-friendly source.
assets.promptSubject: a bursting seed pod releasing glowing seeds into the dark
assets.notes: Pairs with particle systems in the renderer.
